articles.summary: Trinity Industries, Inc. (NYSE: TRN) (“Trinity”), a leading provider of railcar products and services across North America, is aware of and will fully defend against the antidumping and countervailing duty petition filed by UTLX Manufacturing LLC (“UTLX”), a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc. UTLX filed its petition with the U.S. Department of Commerce and the U.S. International Trade Commission targeting imports of railway tank cars from Mexico. Trinity is carefully reviewing the petition with its legal and trade counsel and intends to participate fully and actively in both the Department of Commerce and ITC proceedings. Trinity will vigorously defend its position at every stage of this process. Trinity has produced more than 73,000 tank cars in the United States over the last 15 years. Trinity employs more than 2,500 U.S.-based employees supporting the tank car industry, between its Longview, Texas manufacturing facility and maintenance shops across the country,
articles.title: Trinity Industries Statement on Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Petition Filed Against Railway Tank Car Imports from Mexico
